marketNotes.text: Consumer shops (Alternate, Reichelt, Jacob, Future-X, TopTen, billiger.de offers) show prices incl. 19% VAT. B2B shops (Bechtle, Senetic, EDP, Böttcher AG) show net prices first; those are recorded with vatIncluded false.

No LTO-10 40 TB cartridge (Fujifilm 16978170, Quantum MR-A10MQN-01, IBM 40 TB) had a price at any German seller checked on 2026-10-23, and Geizhals lists none. Stor IT Back still mentions 40/100 TB 'Premium' LTO-10 tapes, quote only.

As of 2026-10-23 no half-height LTO-10 drive is listed in Germany. The only LTO-10 drives with a price are still the full-height MagStor desktops at EDP: SAS EUR 21,000 net (recorded) and Thunderbolt 3/USB4 EUR 21,900 net (not SAS, omitted).
No new standalone LTO-6 drive with a price was found; sellers list only LTO-6 library drive kits or refurbished loader drives.
HPE P84142-B25 (external) and P77034-B25 (1U rackmount) are LTO-9 drive bundles that include 5 cartridges, per Bechtle's product text, so they sit above bare-drive prices.
Quantum sells each drive as bare (-BR), kit (-EY), SAS HBA bundle (-FZ) and 1U rackmount (TC-L83CN/TC-L93CN) SKUs; price gaps within a generation often come from the bundle, not the seller.

Galaxus, Cyberport, Conrad, Proshop, computeruniverse, Mindfactory and Amazon.de still block direct fetches (2026-10-23). Their offers come from billiger.de price lists, or Geizhals where billiger.de had none (seller as named in the offer, comparison page as URL); marketplace offers, including voelkner Marktplatz, were skipped.

billiger.de shows Jacob and bueromarkt-ag.de at prices that differ from their own shops (Fujifilm LTO-9 at bueromarkt-ag.de: EUR 115.98 on billiger.de vs EUR 79.99 net on the shop), so only the shops' own pages were used for them.
evolt24 and etoh24 list single-cartridge titles at multi-pack prices (Quantum LTO-8 EUR 440.60, HPE LTO-8 EUR 533.29); omitted.
Jacob's search listing showed HPE BC023A at EUR 11,883.48 'Sofort lieferbar', but the product page said 'nicht verfügbar' with no price; omitted.
TopTen Storage lists a labeled HP LTO-7 WORM cartridge (C7977WL) at EUR 29.90; looks like a listing error, omitted.

Böttcher AG shows net quantity tiers (1, 5, 10 units, or 1, 2, 3 for IBM); the 1-unit price is recorded. Its bot wall blocks scripted fetches, but on 2026-10-23 the LTO-6 to LTO-10 pages loaded in a normal browser, so LTO-8, LTO-8 WORM and LTO-10 listings were added.
backup-store.de is a parked domain for sale, not a shop.

2026-10-23: the Quantum TC-L82AN-BR LTO-8 internal drive rose at every gross-price seller since September: Future-X EUR 6,644.19 (was 5,651.79), Jacob EUR 6,777.06 (was 5,764.81), Galaxus EUR 6,724.17 (was 5,731.70), JB-Computer EUR 7,530.78 (was 5,688.99).

2026-10-23: EDP raised most net prices since September, e.g. Quantum LTO-6 MR-L6MQN-03 EUR 39 (was 31), Quantum LTO-8 MR-L8MQN-01 EUR 65 (was 55), Quantum LTO-8 TC-L82AN-EY drive kit EUR 6,087 (was 5,000).

2026-10-23: Senetic's September reductions have ended: HPE BC022A LTO-8 internal drive EUR 9,171.66 net (was 4,657.89 on sale), HPE BB874A LTO-7 external EUR 6,287.95 net (was 4,264.47); both out of stock.

2026-10-23: the Quantum TC-L92BN-AR LTO-9 external kit moved up about 20 to 30%: Bechtle EUR 9,761 net (was 7,491), Galaxus EUR 11,002.91 gross (was 8,441.59), Future-X EUR 10,283.09 gross (was 8,634.09).
